classification: Candidate H1 shared SDK session-refresh/read blockage; not proven to be koi's production mechanism
trigger: After controlled H2 recovery, disable user:pij via session.rpc.extensions.disable, wait for lease expiry, perform manual inbox recovery, then enable user:pij via session.rpc.extensions.enable from the private companion while the same Copilot host/session stays alive.
observed_after_deadline: The private adapter logged real-backward-recovery with 128 events after receive-held; exact later latency was not recorded. No lease renewal or message reinjection followed.
production_relation: Koi's old receiver had no per-call deadline, so this class of blocked read could present as silent waiting. Its incident followed abort/model change, not an observed explicit SDK enable. The shared mechanism, whether cleanup unblocked the read, and permanent versus transient waiting remain unproven.
confounders: Isolated deterministic provider, synthetic history, and controlled callback/old-cursor fault adapter; backward reads themselves call the actual SDK without injected delay.
